loadingTable: Loading the table from the relay…
pieceSeedHelp: Everyone gets the same pieces in the same order, so the match is a race, not a lottery.
boardSeedHelp: The same seed always builds the same board, on every client.
turnClockHelp: The clock runs per action, and a Vesta turn is several. A short one will cut people off.
controlsHelp: Click an action, then press the key you want. Saved in this browser.

vesta.robber: Pick a tile for the robber.

meta.chainReaction: Place orbs, set off chain reactions and take the board.
meta.vesta: Expanding Settlements Through Accord: build, trade, and take the board.
meta.stacker: Falling blocks, shared piece order, and every line you clear buries somebody else.

newGame.everyoneHere: {summary}. Everyone plays here; the card in the channel lets others watch.
newGame.hostSeated: {summary}. You are seated as the host; everyone else joins from the chat card.
newGame.waitsInChannel: The table waits in the channel until you start it.
newGame.startsSolo: Starts straight away, on your own. Everyone else needs their own device: every board runs at the same time.
newGame.startsHotSeat: Starts straight away with {count} players taking turns at this keyboard.

newGame.notVestaSave: That file is not a Vesta save.

startTable.realtimeHelp: Every player needs their own device: {game} runs all the boards at once, so one seat per account.
startTable.resumeHelp: Resuming a saved {game} game with {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}}. Assign each one to an account: several seats on the same account are played at that person's keyboard.
startTable.assignHelp: Assign each seat to an account. Give one account several seats and those players share that machine; one seat each means everyone plays from their own client.

detail.orbs: Orbs held when the board was taken
